rootCauseAnalysis.summary: Application and DB path are robust through 200 concurrent authenticated VUs after rate-limit relax. Failures above 200 VU are Cloudflare free quick-tunnel edge throttling, not Job Mitra API 5xx or Layer-3 rateLimitChaos.

rateLimiterBypass.evidence: Waves 1–3 (1→200 VU) authFail=0; successful /auth/me returned X-RateLimit-Class=global and X-RateLimit-Remaining≈199998 under WM_LOAD_TEST_RELAX_RATE_LIMIT=1

infrastructureBlocker.symptom: At 500 concurrent /auth/me: ~200 HTTP 200 + ~300 HTTP 429 with empty body and NO X-RateLimit-* headers
infrastructureBlocker.classification: Cloudflare trycloudflare.com quick-tunnel / edge throttle (not application rateLimitChaos)
infrastructureBlocker.blocks: True 500–1000 VU authenticated RLS certification through this gateway

positives: JSON API confirmed (not SPA HTML fallback)
Authenticated cookie session + RLS reads healthy at ≤200 concurrent

supabaseMetrics.observe: Supabase Dashboard → Database → Connections (Supavisor + Postgres) and Query performance for window ~2026-08-10T09:14Z
supabaseMetrics.interpretation: Peak useful DB/RLS stress is the 200-VU wave (0 authFail). 500–1000 VU waves are partially blocked at tunnel edge before Postgres.
